limitations: Single headless desktop Chromium on this host; no actual mobile, transfer, memory or ordinary workload percentile verdict
Heartbeat measures main-thread timer/DOM updates, not compositor paint or physical input latency
Timeout acknowledgement is promise/UI error handling minus 2000 ms; cancel acknowledgement starts at DOM click handler, not external input delivery
Worker recreation/startup takes longer than 250 ms; the target here is acknowledgement/responsive UI, not completed runtime restart
Browser scheduling/background throttling can delay the main-thread deadline; not a hard real-time guarantee
No deterministic real compile hang exercised; compile containment tested by silent fake worker and shared whole-evaluation deadline
Output cap applies after Python result allocation; bounded inputs do not constitute a hard memory sandbox
